description: Hello! I am from Lodhran, Punjab, Pakistan. My team name is Kisan Dost. We want to make a simple and useful app for people of Pakistan. Our app will help people in daily life. I am looking for team members who want to work with me. Thank you!
summary:
Kisan Dost is a smart farming web app built for small farmers in Pakistan. It helps farmers decide when to irrigate, sow, and protect crops by turning complex NASA satellite data into simple, local-language advice.

The app uses NASA Earth observation data to show soil moisture, rainfall forecast, temperature, and crop health. It gives daily alerts in easy Urdu, a crop calendar, and a water-saving irrigation guide. Farmers can check their village weather and get clear actions like "Do not irrigate today, rain is expected."

Our goal is to reduce water waste, increase crop yield, and help farmers adapt to climate change. Kisan Dost makes space data useful for the people who feed us.
details:
Kisan Dost is a web app that helps small farmers make better decisions using NASA satellite data.

What does it do?
The farmer opens the app, selects the village, and sees soil moisture, rain forecast, temperature, and crop health in simple Urdu. It tells the farmer what to do today, for example, irrigate, wait for rain, or protect the crop from heat.

How does it work?
It uses NASA Earth observation data like GPM rainfall, SMAP soil moisture, and MODIS/Landsat imagery. The data is simplified into daily alerts, a 7-day crop calendar, and a water-saving guide. The frontend is built with HTML, CSS, JavaScript and hosted on Vercel.

Impact:
It saves water, reduces crop loss, and helps farmers adapt to climate change. It brings space data to the village in a language farmers understand.
